topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture by recapping prior histopathology practicals and setting out the learning outcomes on cancer genetics and transformation.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Cancer and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and describe the experimental assays used to demonstrate cell transformation.

topics.label: Classifications and Pathway Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate how they disrupt cell cycle control pathways.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Stepwise Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular causes of sequence and chromosomal instability and show how these defects drive multistep tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition Syndromes and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development across specific hereditary syndromes and affect subsequent tumor evolution.
